description:
Activate Niko by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Niko enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Niko trigger, creating two Shard tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Niko.
Activate the Shards by tapping them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
